##### Project general facts

Luxury Canal Residences by Prestige One is a serene waterfront retreat nestled along the harbor of Dubai Islands, offering an elegant fusion of tranquility and modern sophistication. Thoughtfully designed for those who appreciate peaceful, elevated living, the development mirrors the gentle rhythm of the sea, creating an atmosphere where life flows effortlessly. With its graceful architecture and seamless connection to nature, the residences exude timeless charm and refined simplicity.

The development offers a comprehensive array of lifestyle-enhancing amenities spread across the ground and podium levels, including an infinity pool, spa, wellness area, sports courts, a miniature golf course, outdoor cinema, and a children's adventure park. Residents can unwind in the Prestige Owners' Lounge or enjoy the canal promenade, while every detail is designed to enrich the everyday experience. The community celebrates leisure, luxury, and meaningful living through thoughtfully curated spaces.

Each residence features modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating living spaces that exude sophistication and contemporary elegance. The spacious layouts, sophisticated finishes, and floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light and frame soothing water views, creating a calming ambiance. Serene design elements, warm tones, and contemporary elegance allow residents to enjoy a sanctuary that nurtures well-being and harmony at every turn.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated on Dubai Islands, a magnificent group of islands located to the north of the city that offers diverse island living and a vacation-inspired lifestyle. The area features an array of luxury resort offerings, village centres with services and entertainment, elite wellness and sports venues, beautiful beaches for water sports, and vibrant green spaces for outdoor leisure pursuits. The islands offer stunning waterfront homes and hotels in an idyllic setting that connects sandy shores, inviting water edges, and world-class amenities to the mainland via a striking bridge.

The contemporary landscaped residential development boasts beautiful residences of apartment and villa typologies, an on-site luxury hotel, and an extensive array of enviable amenities dedicated to residence owners, including stunning pools, lush green garden terraces, and a pristine beachfront. Residents enjoy a world of wellness activities and water sports combined with the services of an exclusive luxury resort in a friendly resort-style neighborhood. The area's strategic location ensures seamless access to the rest of the city.

The location offers the perfect blend of island tranquility and urban accessibility, allowing residents to enjoy a vacation-inspired lifestyle while remaining connected to Dubai's vibrant urban centers. The area's commitment to luxury living, natural beauty, and world-class amenities makes it a premier destination for discerning residents. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of waterfront serenity, resort-style living, and urban convenience, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of Dubai's most exclusive island destinations.
